result.summary: This PR adds unit tests covering block validation consensus rules across four categories: header, stateless, contextual, and stateful validation. It tests targeted block mutations against three validation entry points: TestBlockValidity, ProcessNewBlock, and ConnectBlock. It also adds reusable testing utilities in src/test/util/block_validity for constructing mutated blocks and checking validation outcomes.
result.problem: Block validation logic is critical and exercised through multiple entry points, but relies heavily on functional and fuzz tests rather than fast unit tests. Subtle regressions can slip through code review during modularization refactors, as occurred during review of PR #32317.

resolved_concerns: A fuzz harness added in early revisions overlapped with PR #34651 and was removed per feedback from marcofleon.
Tests initially only covered TestBlockValidity; sedited requested extending coverage to ProcessNewBlock and ConnectBlock, which the author implemented.
Handling of outpoint creation helper failures was made strict with assertions rather than early returns based on feedback from w0xlt.
